headline: Robinhood Crypto Revenue Drops 55% Year-Over-Year but Beats Expectations
summary: Robinhood reported a 55% year-on-year drop in cryptocurrency revenue alongside a 38% decrease in trading volumes, although overall results surpassed Wall Street forecasts.
why: Robinhood is a prominent retail trading platform whose revenue trends reflect retail investor sentiment across equities, options, and digital assets.

impacts.name: Robinhood Markets, Inc.
impacts.why: Revenues beat analyst expectations despite ongoing headwinds in retail cryptocurrency trading volumes.
